name: Rothe Florists & Flower Delivery
tagline: Flowers That Actually Show Up Beautiful.
brandNarrative:
Rothe Florists & Flower Delivery on Germantown Avenue is the kind of flower shop that makes skeptics into believers. Customers who had already struck out at other florists — like Michelle Bennett, who visited Rothe's website as a last resort — walk away stunned by how seamlessly an order comes together. Whether you're placing a next-day order online, calling from overseas (yes, Rothe serves international customers sending flowers to loved ones in Philly), or walking in on the day before Valentine's Day hoping for a miracle, Rothe delivers — literally and figuratively. Jim Lowther, who had ordered from 'many places,' called Rothe's dozen rose bouquet the most beautiful he had ever received. That's not a small claim. That's a florist doing something right, consistently, with 460 reviews averaging 4.9 stars to prove it.

What separates Rothe isn't just the quality of the blooms — it's the human layer wrapped around every transaction. Staff member Anthony fielded an in-store retirement arrangement order and was called out by name for being 'kind and helpful.' When an international customer named Rebekah ran into a card-issuing block on her overseas purchase, the shop owner personally spotted the issue and resolved it via email — fast. That level of attentiveness is rare. Rothe even sources locally: their gift add-ons like chocolates and candles come from local Philadelphia makers, packaged neatly alongside arrangements. It's a shop that thinks beyond the bouquet.

Rothe's identity lives at the intersection of craft and reliability — two things the floral industry often fumbles. Their arrangements are called 'full and beautiful,' their delivery is on-time and confirmed with a personal call, and their designer's-choice arrangements surprise customers with genuine creativity. The shop carries the quiet confidence of a neighborhood institution: open six days a week, rooted on Germantown Avenue, and clearly beloved by Mount Airy and the wider Philadelphia community.
ownerStory: The owner of Rothe Florists is the kind of person who notices when something is wrong before you do. When Rebekah, a customer sending flowers from Ireland, had her payment flagged by her bank, the owner caught the issue proactively and reached out immediately to help resolve it — no frustration, no dropped order, just clear and friendly communication that made a stressful situation disappear. That responsiveness isn't an accident; it reflects a shop built on the belief that getting a flower delivery right is a matter of personal responsibility, not just logistics. Anthony, one of the team's customer-facing standouts, embodies the same ethos — described by customers as 'kind and helpful,' he's the kind of person who makes you feel like your order genuinely matters, whether it's a retirement bouquet or a last-minute Valentine's arrangement. Together, they've built a florist that's earned the trust of Philadelphia neighbors and international senders alike.

reviews.text: I was very happy with the flower arrangement I purchased for Valentine’s Day. The service was efficient and timely, arriving in my requested time frame. I appreciated the reasonable prices on short notice and the quality of the flowers. I also bought chocolates and a candle that were both from local places and packaged neatly.
reviews.author: Daniel Terbush

reviews.text: After striking out at a couple of other florists, I visited the Rothe website. I was excited that it would allow me to place an order for the next day. I knew that I wanted to send a peace lily. The website listed a 10" basket. That sounded great. Now, will the plant arrive on time and be beautiful? Shortly after completing my order. I received a call to confirm the delivery location, which further confirmed timely delivery. It did! The plant was full and beautiful. I  was pleasantly surprised. It was a bit pricey, but anyone, myself included, would have loved to take it home! It was snatched up before I could take a photo.
reviews.author: Michelle Bennett

reviews.text: This place was awesome! Ordering was simple and my wife loved the flowers. I’ve ordered from many places and none were able to get the flowers delivered on time and to the correct place. Rothe not only did both but they crafted the most beautiful dozen rose bouquet I have ever ordered. Not only will I be using them exclusively for all my future orders but I am passing their info on to all of my friends and co-workers as well. 5 stars, would highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Jim Lowther

reviews.text:
This was my first time ever sending flowers long distance, and I couldn’t have chosen a better florist. After reading the reviews, and coming across a positive review left from someone else sending from Ireland, I went ahead and chose Rothe Florists, and I am SO glad I did. The flowers arrived exactly on Valentine’s Day as promised, and they were absolutely beautiful, actually went above and beyond expectations. My boyfriend loved them, and they truly made the whole occasion feel extra special.

The shop’s communication was quick, clear, reassuring and friendly throughout the whole process. It’s tricky sometimes because your card issuer might mistake and block the transaction for overseas purchases, but the shop owner straight away noticed, and they helped resolve it immediately via email. I was extremely thankful for that. It’s rare to find a shop where the reviews genuinely reflect the service, but here, they absolutely do.

They definitely would be my go to flower shop from now on. And I can absolutely see why they’re the best. When I’m over visiting, I’ll pop in and get some for myself! I couldn’t recommend them enough. Thank you so much Rothe Florists.

Rebekah.
reviews.author: Weegreens

reviews.text: I ordered an arrangement, designer's choice, to celebrate my sister-in-law's retirement.  The designer created a beautiful arrangement and Anthony could not have been more kind and helpful taking my order and checking me out at the shop.  I don't order flowers often but when I do, I go to Rothe's!
reviews.author: Joan Brooks

team.name: Anthony
team.bio: Anthony takes in-store orders and manages customer checkout with a warmth that customers remember by name. Joan Brooks specifically praised his kindness and helpfulness when she ordered a designer's-choice arrangement for her sister-in-law's retirement.
credentials: Named by customers for exceptional in-person service

faq.question: Can I place an order for next-day delivery?
faq.answer: Yes — Rothe's website allows next-day orders, and customers consistently report receiving a personal confirmation call shortly after ordering to verify delivery details. Multiple reviewers have praised how smoothly last-minute orders are handled, even for major holidays like Valentine's Day.

faq.question: Can I send flowers to Philadelphia from another city or country?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Rothe regularly fulfills orders from out-of-town and international customers. One customer sending flowers from Ireland noted that the shop owner personally helped resolve a payment flagging issue via email — quickly and kindly. The experience was described as rare and exceptional.

faq.question: How do I know my flowers will actually arrive on time?
faq.answer: Rothe confirms every delivery with a personal call to verify the delivery address and time frame. Customers across multiple reviews specifically praised the on-time, accurate delivery — something that distinguished Rothe from other florists they had tried.

faq.question: What if I don't know exactly what arrangement I want?
faq.answer: Rothe offers a designer's-choice option where their in-house floral designer creates a custom arrangement. Customers who've chosen this option have been genuinely delighted — one described a retirement arrangement as 'beautiful,' and another said a peace lily plant was so stunning it 'was snatched up before I could take a photo.'

faq.question: Do you offer anything beyond flowers — like gift add-ons?
faq.answer: Yes. Rothe carries locally sourced chocolates and candles that can be added to your order and are packaged neatly alongside the floral arrangement. It's a thoughtful touch that makes their deliveries feel like a complete, curated gift.

faq.question: Are your prices reasonable for the quality?
faq.answer: Most customers find Rothe's pricing fair given the quality and reliability. One reviewer noted 'reasonable prices on short notice' for a Valentine's Day order. A peace lily was noted as 'a bit pricey' but described as so beautiful it was immediately taken home by the recipient — suggesting the value is clearly felt.

brandColors.note: Deep botanical green reflects the lush, full floral craftsmanship Rothe is known for — rooted, natural, and neighborhood-genuine. The warm terracotta accent echoes the locally sourced candles and chocolates, the warmth of Anthony's in-person service, and the intimate, human character that runs through every review.

top_3_strengths: Exceptional on-time delivery with personal confirmation calls — repeatedly cited as differentiating Rothe from competitors who failed customers on timing
Genuine human responsiveness at every touchpoint — from Anthony's warmth in-store to the owner personally resolving an international payment issue via email
Consistently stunning floral craftsmanship — multiple reviewers use superlatives like 'most beautiful I've ever ordered' and 'went above and beyond expectations'
common_complaints: Pricing on some items (notably plants) was noted as 'a bit pricey' by one reviewer, though the quality was acknowledged as justifying the cost
